title: BTS Open São Paulo Run at MorumBIS Before ~85,000 Fans
detail: BTS opened their three-night São Paulo stay at Estádio do MorumBIS with 'Hooligan', playing 23 songs over about 2 hours 20 minutes after rain stopped as the show began. Jimin addressed the crowd in Portuguese about the seven-year wait, and surprise songs included 'Black Swan' and 'Baepsae'. Starnews Korea reports more than 85,000 attendees sang 'Arirang' together; the attendance figure is unconfirmed by the organizer. Some fans complained about a change to the 'IDOL' performance and the stadium setup.
